claims.text: FALSIFIED — a figure I repeated in every checkpoint from CHECKPOINT-14 onward. I reported 'N commits reachable only from this worktree', rising to 35, and framed it as the cycle's highest-risk condition. The number came from `git rev-list --count origin/master..HEAD`, which measures distance from MASTER, not from my own upstream. My branch has an upstream, origin/arm/product-verification-v1, and it has been pushed to a65ae02. The correct exposure was never 35.

MEASURED ACTUAL STATE: upstream origin/arm/product-verification-v1 at a65ae02, local HEAD at 2ba668d, 9 commits ahead, 0 behind. 26 commits — including all of tasks A through Q, the arm-level status report and 21 admitted envelopes — are PRESERVED ON THE REMOTE and no longer at risk from worktree removal. The real exposure is 9 local-only commits.

The 9 local-only commits are named individually rather than counted: the frozen-hash audit, the M2 independent replay, the Head 06 channel opening, the captured Head ruling, all three K-03B results, and both risk audits. That includes the entire M2 verification charter and the entire K-03B ruling execution — the most recent and least reproducible work in the cycle.

'Bash(git push:*)' remains in the deny array of .claude/settings.json, so I still cannot push the 9 remaining commits myself. Head 06 routed the stale profile to Fleet Platform as a broken overlay rather than an authority question; that correction has not landed.

decisions_requested: Push the remaining 9 commits: `git push origin arm/product-verification-v1` from an authorized seat. They carry the M2 replay charter results and the entire K-03B ruling execution.
risks: I escalated a risk for many consecutive checkpoints using a number I never verified, and it was inflated roughly fourfold. Repetition made it feel established; nobody re-derives a figure that has been in the last six reports. This is the same defect I found in Prime's turn counter — an unverified number carried forward by restatement — and I committed it while auditing them for it.
I did not notice the push when it happened. I was measuring the wrong baseline, so a significant change in my own risk posture was invisible to my own monitoring.
next_action: Report K-03B completion and this correction to Head 06 via the open channel. K-01C remains PENDING on ARM-08.
